card.name: The word trials after clinical
card.fires_on: The noun trial, trials or studies right after the word clinical, in drug-label text. It also fires on the or on clinical itself in phrases such as in the clinical trials.

modes.label: Trial noun after clinical
modes.description: The word trial, trials or studies completes the phrase clinical trial(s) or Clinical Studies.
modes.example: In clinical<< trials>>, hypersensitivity reactions, including rash,

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: Studies after Clinical in a bracketed section cross-reference.
modes.example: [see Dosage and Administration (2.2) and Clinical<< Studies>> (14.4) ]

modes.label: Just before clinical trials
modes.description: The word the or clinical right before the clinical trial noun.
modes.example: were observed with HIBSAGO administration in<< the>> clinical trials, glomeruloneph

card.writes: Little clear effect; it slightly favors words like expressly and explicitly.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says clinical trials or clinical studies.
